description: Sri Lanka Council of Archaeologists - New Constitutions made in terms of section 6(1) of the Sri Lanka Council of Archaelogists Act No. 04 of 1992
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the repeal of old rules and enactment of new rules/constitution for the Sri Lanka Council of Archaeologists under the Council of Archaeologists Act No. 04 of 1992. It establishes legal frameworks, membership requirements, governance structures, and regulatory procedures for the archaeological profession, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
